title: Crimson Figure on the Edge
description: A lone figure in a flowing red robe sits on a rocky cliff edge, gazing toward a dramatic sky filled with swirling clouds of fiery orange, yellow, and teal. The foreground shows broken stone fragments under a painterly, atmospheric glow.
prompt: A solitary figure wearing a long flowing red robe sits on the edge of a broken rocky cliff, looking out at a vast dramatic sky filled with swirling clouds of bright orange, yellow, and teal. Painterly digital art style with visible brush strokes, atmospheric lighting, broken stone fragments in the foreground, cinematic composition, moody and contemplative atmosphere.
